what-is-one-ui.question: What is One UI?
what-is-one-ui.answer: A collection of animated React components built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. You copy the source into your project and own it from there.

is-it-free.question: Is it free?
is-it-free.answer: Yes. Every component is free to use in personal and commercial projects.

install.question: How do I install a component?
install.answer: Add it with the shadcn CLI. The source lands in your components/ui folder, ready to edit.

commercial-use.question: Can I use it in commercial projects?
commercial-use.answer: Yes, closed source included, as long as you credit One UI with a visible link to ui.huzhihui.com.

resell.question: Can I resell the components?
resell.answer: No. You can't sell, sublicense, or redistribute them on their own, or bundled into a template, kit, theme, or course.
